detail.title: A kind of vacuum pump electronic controller
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a kind of vacuum pump electronic controller, including: a pressure transducer, detects vacuum tank air pressure inside in real time and exports corresponding air pressure actual value；One vibrating sensor, actual value is vibrated in Oscillation Amplitude the output of detection vacuum pump in real time accordingly；One control module, electrically connects with described pressure transducer and described vibrating sensor respectively；One vacuum pump drives module, bridges the driving motor of described control module and described vacuum pump；And an alarm module, electrically connect with described control module.Ground atmospheric pressure value in vacuum tank stablized by this kind of vacuum pump electronic controller.Moreover it is possible to remind the human pilot in car or member to find the vibration problem of vacuum pump in time by the way of warning, thus ensure braking safety and the reliability of vacuum booster.
